Following are the results for the '''1994–95 [[Belgian Pro League|Belgian First Division]]''' professional [[association football]] season. [[R.S.C. Anderlecht]] won the title of the '''1994–95''' season.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Belgium championship 1994/95 |url=https://eu-football.info/_tournament.php?id=461 |access-date=2025-06-06 |website=Eu-football.info |language=en}}</ref>

This was the final season in which two points were awarded for a win; going forward this changed to [[Three points for a win|three points]].
